name: IGNATIUS FRAME
walkToNote: Thad is where he stood to ask; he turns to him.
note: IGNATIUS FRAME, stood back from his press with the funeral notice set (doc 118 O-2, errata 250): the same man and the same sheet as `frame`, by his back editions, so that the press is Thad's to pull. He is here only between the asking and the pull.
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for Frame.

sprite.frameNote: 0 rest, his notebook at his side · 1 breath (derived) · 2 talking, a hand out · 3 taking a quote in his notebook, the pencil from behind his ear · 4 leaning in · 5 the Clarion lifted from his side, his notebook under the other arm · 6 the Clarion thrust out to his left, at Thad (doc 95 row 98; cast-unify 87, errata 214). Breathing on 0 and 1; every `breakEvery` seconds one break (errata 77).
sprite.redrawn: Errata 111 (Tyler, 2026-11-06): drawn from the locked cast master, cast-unify operation 18 (reference/cast-unify-16.txt), full figure, holding his own thing in every pose so it never appears or vanishes; cut with its own pixels and a clean edge on his feet. Its own file: the sheet it replaces is written by an earlier cut.
